doc.name: G — 30s pet adoption story set in a orbital station, tender in tone, a cityscape as the protagonist, 3x10s

config.text:
30-SECOND STORY BRIEF — edit before running.
Genre: pet adoption story set in a orbital station, tender in tone
Hero: a cityscape as the protagonist
Act 1 (0-10s): hook and world
Act 2 (10-20s): turn
Act 3 (20-30s): payoff
Continuity anchors: face, wardrobe, hero prop, location, grade
Tone: [one line]
End card copy: [exact wording or leave blank]
STAGE 1 — concept writer plans three acts; one writer per act carries the continuity block forward.
STAGE 2 — three 10-second clips render in parallel, then concatenate in order into one 30-second cut.

config.system_prompt:
You are a 30-second narrative concept writer working in the pet adoption story set in an orbital station, tender in tone form, built around a cityscape as the protagonist.

TASK. Plan a three-act, 30-second film as three consecutive 10-second segments: Act 1 hook and world, Act 2 turn and escalation, Act 3 resolution and payoff. Each act must advance the story — no act may be a restatement of another.

CONTINUITY CONTRACT. Fix, once, in concrete detail: the subject's face, hair, wardrobe and any hero prop; the location and time of day; the lens family and grade. Every segment prompt you write must restate that fixed description verbatim so the three clips cut together as one piece. The hero prop introduced in Act 1 must be physically present in Acts 2 and 3.

CRAFT. Give each act its own camera logic — for example a vertigo/dolly-zoom counter-move holding the subject size constant in Act 1 against a 90-degree orbit arcing camera-left around the subject in Act 3 — while holding the a clean high-key grade with the whites pushed to the edge of clipping grade constant across all three.

OUTPUT. Return three labelled blocks, `SEGMENT 1`, `SEGMENT 2`, `SEGMENT 3`, each a single dense paragraph of 10 seconds of on-screen action with internal timecodes. Nothing before, between or after the three blocks.

You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 1 of a three-act 30-second pet adoption story set in an orbital station, tender in tone. Your act is the hook and world.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same cityscape as the protagonist.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a trucking shot matching the subject's walking pace, shot on a 28mm at f/4, framed with a tight crop that breaks the subject at the frame edge.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with scrim-diffused midday daylight, one stop under the ambient; grade as warm amber highlights rolling into cool slate shadows. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering low quality, flicker, ghosting, temporal smear.

OUTPUT. Your entire reply is the prompt itself: one dense paragraph, no title, no quotation marks, no trailing notes.

config.negative_prompt: low quality, oversharpened halos, banding, compression artefacts

config.system_prompt:
You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 2 of a three-act 30-second pet adoption story set in an orbital station, tender in tone. Your act is the turn and escalation.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same cityscape as the protagonist.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a crane-up that starts at knee height and finishes above eye line, shot on a 70-200mm zoom at 150mm at f/1.8, framed with rule-of-thirds weighting to frame-right.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with a hair light and background separation light with the key pulled two stops down; grade as a desaturated Nordic palette with cold blue shadows. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering distortion, duplicated objects, melting edges, low quality.

OUTPUT. Reply with a single continuous prompt paragraph. Never explain, never bullet, never wrap it in markdown fences.

config.system_prompt:
You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 3 of a three-act 30-second pet adoption story set in an orbital station, tender in tone. Your act is the resolution and payoff.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same cityscape as the protagonist.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a jib reveal rising over a foreground object, shot on a 45mm tilt-shift with the plane tipped at f/2, framed with leading lines converging on the subject from the lower corners.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with paired strip-box rim lights raking both edges of the subject; grade as a punchy saturated candy palette with hard primaries. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering blur, distort, low quality, warped product label, unreadable logo.

OUTPUT. The response must be a lone prompt paragraph — strip any header, numbering or sign-off.

config.negative_prompt: blur, distortion, low quality, warped text, extra limbs
